method: Independent semantic review of a supplied source/plan/card packet; no filesystem or native-app verification by the reviewer. Root verified the exact source/card bytes and file outcomes separately.
qualification: The original workshop source does not explicitly state whether the 45-minute break applies to each session or the overall workshop. The generated plan applies a reusable break/resume/close template to both sessions without labeling that structure as an assumption. The card accurately summarizes that saved plan but inherits this qualification.
